mapper.select: SELECT id, sku, merchant_id, product_name, price, stock_quantity, sold_quantity, version, created_at, updated_at FROM product_inventory WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND sku = #{sku} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_inventory (sku, merchant_id, product_name, price, stock_quantity, sold_quantity, version) VALUES (#{sku}, #{merchantId}, #{productName}, #{price, typeHandler=com.example.tradesystem.user.infrastructure.mapper.MoneyTypeHandler}, #{stockQuantity}, #{soldQuantity}, #{version})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_inventory SET stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, sold_quantity = #{soldQuantity}, price = #{price, typeHandler=com.example.tradesystem.user.infrastructure.mapper.MoneyTypeHandler}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
